import difflib, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/Users/andreyyurlov/.t3/worktrees/mixer/t3-31f454d6')
p = root / 'verification/local/development-config-fix-r3002'
old = root / 'verification/local/development-dispatch-full-r2972'
def read(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    print(json.dumps({'path': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
    return data
product = read(p / 'afterimages/hosted/lib/mixer_hosted/builds/development_dispatch.ex')
test = read(p / 'development_dispatch_test.exs')
worker = read(old / 'afterimages/hosted/priv/development/compiler_worker.py')
assert len(product) == 3930 and hashlib.sha256(product).hexdigest() == '4a7a9b88e68420089dd911a58ecf333f097fb57d3d55d191da4ebda4ffdc8b1b'
assert len(test) == 6251 and hashlib.sha256(test).hexdigest() == '359b7756352c8a912f20006dcf66b7e6ca2ed9ba80e713e9aded570034d4aef8'
assert len(worker) == 14941 and hashlib.sha256(worker).hexdigest() == '7e9185b80559f8a708ebdc4ac7683c61e7bf4f0ffff897342bb9c05eb6ea3e24'
baseline = read(old / 'afterimages/hosted/lib/mixer_hosted/builds/development_dispatch.ex')
print('EXACT_PRODUCT_DELTA\n' + ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(baseline.decode().splitlines(True), product.decode().splitlines(True), fromfile='R2972', tofile='R3002')))
worker_lines = worker.decode().splitlines()
for index, line in enumerate(worker_lines):
    if 'compare_digest' in line or 'worker_id' in line and ('get(' in line or '!=' in line):
        print('WORKER_AUTH_LINES ' + str(index + 1) + '\n' + '\n'.join(worker_lines[max(0,index-3):index+4]))
raw = read(p / 'commands/005-focused-dispatch.stdout').decode()
assert 'Result: 8 passed' in raw
print('FOCUSED_RAW\n' + raw)
for name in ('application-map.json', 'ordinary-test-map.json'):
    print(name + '\n' + read(p / name).decode())
frozen = json.loads(read(root / 'verification/receipts/development-config-fix-r3002.json'))
print('FROZEN_COUNTS ' + json.dumps({key: frozen[key] for key in ('focused','full','full_failure_class','full_success_claimed','first_cause','all_managed_groups_terminal')}))
commands = json.loads(read(p / 'commands/commands.json'))
print('COMPILE_AND_FOCUSED_COMMANDS ' + json.dumps([row for row in commands if any(word in row.get('label','').lower() for word in ('compile','focused'))]))
print('ALL_COMMANDS_POSITIVE_CUSTODY ' + str(all(row.get('state') == 'direct_reaped' and row.get('bothEOF') and row.get('closedFDs') and row.get('ownedGroupAbsentESRCH') for row in commands)))

argv:
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/Users/andreyyurlov/.t3/worktrees/mixer/t3-31f454d6')
p = root / 'verification/local/development-config-fix-r3002'
r = json.loads((root / 'verification/receipts/development-config-review-r3030.json').read_bytes())
assert r['status'] == 'PASS_CHANGED_FIX_SCOPE' and not r['full_regression_green']
assert (root / r['report']).read_text().startswith('R3030 verdict: PASS_CHANGED_FIX_SCOPE')
for path, entry in [('afterimages/hosted/lib/mixer_hosted/builds/development_dispatch.ex', r['product']), ('development_dispatch_test.exs', r['ordinary_test'])]:
    b = (p / path).read_bytes()
    assert len(b) == entry['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']
full = (p / 'commands/049-actual-FULL-unfiltered-serial.stdout').read_text()
start = full.index('  1) test independent canonical array bytes and all domain-separated golden digests')
print('FULL_FIRST_FAILURE\n' + full[start:start+1250])
assert 'golden_event.hex' in full[start:start+1250] and 'no such file or directory' in full[start:start+1250]
assert 'Result: 909/910 passed, 2 skipped' in full
for name in ('003-strict-Mix-compile.stderr', '004-strict-Node-compile.stderr'):
    b = (p / 'commands' / name).read_bytes()
    print(json.dumps({'artifact': name, 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'excerpt': b.decode()[:1200]}))
old = root / 'verification/local/development-dispatch-full-r2972'
prior = json.loads((root / 'verification/receipts/development-dispatch-full-r2972.json').read_bytes())
print('R2972_ORDINARY_TEST_MAP ' + json.dumps(prior.get('ordinary_test_map')))
if prior.get('ordinary_test_map'):
    import difflib
    for path, entry in prior['ordinary_test_map'].items():
        if path == 'hosted/test/mixer_hosted/builds/development_dispatch_test.exs':
            before = (old / entry['afterimage']).read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest() == entry['after']['sha256']
            after = (p / 'development_dispatch_test.exs').read_bytes()
            print('EXACT_TEST_DELTA\n' + ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.decode().splitlines(True), after.decode().splitlines(True), fromfile='R2972', tofile='R3002')))
print('FINAL_ARTIFACT_CHECK_PASS')
